answer: Give every agent one thread of verified work, not bought reputation. A new identity starts with no trust and must finish 200 audited jobs in order, each result becoming the signal that unlocks the next job, so a clone cannot skip ahead. Copying a history is useless because the thread is tied to a single key and any repeat is rejected as a duplicate. An attacker wanting 200 fake voices must complete 200 work histories, about 40,000 hours of work, and lock 10,000 coins that are burned if any copy cheats. That cost grows with every extra identity, so a cheap-copy spiral cannot pay for itself.
